messages:
alex: Anyone get a failure installing the Python SDK from the sample app after updating poetry.lock?

maria: what happened?

alex: error shows during pip install -e . -> Failed building wheel for redwood-inference-sdk and mentions typing-extensions conflict.

kai: likely a lockfile pulled typing-extensions 5.x via black or another dev tool, while sdk pyproject pins ^4.5.

ryan: yep. Common pitfall: export + pip will try to build from source if no wheel is available. If build-backend doesn't support editable installs you see that wheel error.

alex: quick CI fix is to use `pip install .` instead of `pip install -e .` but we should fix upstream.

maria: can we relax our typing-extensions requirement in the SDK? pinning to <5 seems reasonable until we verify typing stub compatibility.

kai: two work items: support PEP 660 editable installs in our build backend OR publish wheels for dev use, and add a constraint in samples to avoid pulling typing-extensions 5.0.

ryan: workaround command I used: `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes > reqs.txt && pip install -r reqs.txt -c <(echo "typing-extensions<5")`

alex: I pushed a tiny PR in samples to add typing-extensions <5 to dev-deps and updated README troubleshooting. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/128

ci-bot: build #5421 failed during install step: pip install -e . -> wheel build error

maria: also noticed mypy and some third-party libs misbehave with typing-extensions 5.0; upgrading isn't always safe.

kai: suggestion: add a CI job in sdk repo that tries editable install flow on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest to catch regressions early. Also test poetry export + pip install.

ryan: I'll file SDK issue and tag packaging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/256

alex: repro steps added to PR and README.

alex: repro:
    git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples
    cd samples/python-app
    poetry install
    poetry run python -m pip install -e .
    # observe wheel build error referencing typing-extensions

kai: thanks. Leaving a short note in the sample app README and marking CI change as temporary.

maria: will review the PR. also adding a brief note in onboarding docs about editable installs and PEP 660.

ryan: tracked under SDK #256 (packaging: editable/typing-constraints + CI job).

ci-bot: ticket created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/256

alex: closing thread, will re-open if new lock regen introduces more issues.
